name: QuerySplat Gaussian Prediction
description: Multi-view image-to-3DGS prediction (VGGT-Omega encoder + QuerySplat decoder) with gsplat-semantics rendering, optional test-time optimization and PLY export, via native GGML inference.

references.text: Shared test data (the same multi-view scene bundles the MapAnything plugin consumes; courtyard's first four frames are byte-identical to the official QuerySplat eval inputs)
